cues.text: Junpei lays Chidori down, faces Takaya.
Junpei's Persona meets Chidori's, Medea; the two merge into a new Persona, a slender masked figure with jagged wings.
Jin takes the blast for Takaya.
Jin throws a grenade. Thick smoke rolls over the steps and everyone below.
Junpei stands with head bowed, then kneels beside Chidori.
